[Pre-reflection] The strategy's reliance on Bollinger Band breakouts may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, while the RSI filter could lag in strong trends. Exit rules based on RSI levels (70/30) might cause premature exits during sustained momentum. ATR-based risk management is promising but needs precise calibration to balance position sizing and volatility.
[Backup plan] If results are poor, I'd test a modified entry using a 20-period RSI filter to avoid overbought conditions, and tighten stop-losses to 1.5x ATR. If Sharpe is low, I'd adjust the RSI threshold to 55-60 for entries and increase the bollinger period to 25. As an alternative, I'd try a breakout filter with volatility confirmation using a 10-period ATR to reduce false signals.
